evidence_rules: This is a dated public-source snapshot, not a purchase order, quote, stock check, teardown, measurement or serviceability result.
Three different brands cannot be pooled into a three-unit same-design repeatability set.
A used donor is not a valid operational control unless it is independently qualified for the declared function/performance comparison.
Model suffix, market version and revision must be frozen before control selection.
Prices and stock observations must be refreshed at purchase time and include delivery, returns, taxes and warranty terms where applicable.
Part compatibility is unknown until documented for the exact model/revision; unknown is not false, zero or an affirmative fit claim.
The exact model-specific safety procedure and required qualifications govern all physical work; a parts benchmark never authorizes hazardous DIY repair.
Every target remains a proposal until the measurement plan is frozen and evidence is collected.
